scope.purpose: Define how to render AFOQT-style 3D block-counting figures using a CSS-based isometric cube grid so players can quickly understand and count stacked blocks.

uiSpecContract.description: All block-counting questions will define their figure using a grid of stacked cubes, rendered in an isometric style.

width.description: Suggested pixel width for the rendering container (e.g., 320–420).

height.description: Suggested pixel height for the rendering container.

cols.description: Number of columns (X direction, left → right).

rows.description: Number of rows (Y/depth direction, front → back).

stacks.description: Each entry describes a single vertical stack of cubes.

col.description: Column index (0-based), increasing left to right.

row.description: Row index (0-based), increasing front to back.

height.description: Number of cubes stacked in this position. 0 = empty column.

coordinateSystem: col = X-axis on the floor, left to right.
row = Y/depth axis on the floor, front (0) to back (rows - 1).
height = Z-axis, number of cubes stacked upward at that floor position.
logicMapping.visualAssumption: Every cube in a stack physically rests on top of the previous one. There are no unsupported floating cubes. Hidden cubes under visible ones still count toward height.

renderingStructure.description: Recommended HTML structure and class layout for rendering the block stacks.
domStructure: Each column is a stack of cubes.
Front rows are at the bottom, back rows are drawn higher.

layoutLogic.scene: bc-scene is the main container, sized by uiSpec.width/height.
layoutLogic.grid: bc-grid uses position: relative; each bc-column is absolutely positioned based on col and row.
columnOffset: X offset per column: col * cubeWidth * 0.7 (approx).
Y offset per row: row * cubeHeight * -0.5 (move rows ‘up’ visually to simulate depth).
layoutLogic.stackOffset: Inside each bc-column, cubes are stacked upward by negative translateY per level.

cssContract.description: Core CSS styles required to render isometric cubes for block counting.
notes: This is a baseline visual; Copilot can theme colors but must preserve geometry.
Cubes are built from one main element (top) plus ::before and ::after for left and right faces.

positioningFunction.description: Given (col, row), compute left/bottom offsets so deeper rows sit visually higher and slightly to the right.

afoqtAlignmentNotes: 1. Figures must be simple, clean isometric stacks that can be mentally converted into column heights.
2. Avoid visual noise: no textures, no perspective distortion beyond simple isometric tilt.
3. Maintain enough contrast so individual cubes and levels are easily distinguishable under time pressure.
4. All hidden supporting cubes must be counted in the height field, matching how AFOQT expects candidates to infer hidden blocks.
5. Use consistent lighting and orientation across all block-counting questions to reduce irrelevant difficulty.
acceptanceCriteria: All block_counting uiSpec entries use type = 'block_stack_iso' and define grid + stacks.
The rendering layer uses the CSS contract here (or a direct derivative) to draw isometric cubes.
Players can clearly see how many cubes are in each stack and can mentally map the 3D figure to a table of column heights.
No question relies on ambiguous shapes; every cube is visually distinct and countable.
